title: OS command execution via Command::new (rust) — review required
description: The rust sink Command::new launches processes. Untrusted input in the command becomes command injection. This lexical rule flags the sink; the reviewer confirms arguments are trusted or passed as vectors via .arg() vectors.
remediation: Use .arg() vectors with separate arguments, never interpolated command strings.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any Command::new call matches. Other languages' launchers are separate rules.
